summary: Aperture AC filed an 8-K announcing the consummation of its IPO of 10,200,000 units at $10.00/unit, including the underwriters' partial over-allotment, for gross proceeds of $102 million. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 311,000 units at $10.00/unit to sponsor and underwriters, raising $3.11 million. Per-unit consideration is cash. Net proceeds of $102.255 million were placed in a trust account. This is a standard SPAC IPO closing report, not a business combination or special situation. Watch for the SPAC's future target announcement.
